success_criteria.description: review code-review-result gate blocks any gate_result that is not semantically aligned with review_conclusion
review findings require repo-local existing file paths and one-based line numbers inside the target file
code-review-result schema rejects parent traversal in findings[].file_path
existing review, canonical, standard-chain, and full regression suites remain passing

issues.title: review gate allowed gate_result and review_conclusion mismatch
issues.symptom: A payload with gate_result PASS and review_conclusion REQUEST_CHANGES passed the review completion hook.

reproduction.red_result: exit 1 before fix; output included {"decision":"allow","reason":"canonical code review result validated"} followed by FAIL: mismatched gate_result and review_conclusion should block

hypotheses.hypothesis: The review skill contract does not define a required mapping.
hypotheses.evidence: shared/skills/review/SKILL.md:94 requires APPROVE => PASS and all other conclusions => FAIL.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The runtime gate validates only field presence and enum membership.
hypotheses.verification_method: Read shared/skills/review/scripts/completion_check.sh and run the RED hook test.
hypotheses.evidence: Pre-fix jq validation accepted .gate_result truthiness and review_conclusion enum; RED test observed allow for PASS + REQUEST_CHANGES.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The shared gate_result enum intentionally allows CONDITIONAL and N_A, so the review gate needs a role-specific semantic check.
hypotheses.verification_method: Read contracts/canonical/schemas/shared-core.schema.json lines 374-382 and compare with review skill line 94.
hypotheses.evidence: shared-core gate_result is broader than review skill semantics; review completion_check now enforces the role-specific mapping at shared/skills/review/scripts/completion_check.sh:83.

root_cause.summary: The gate checked review_conclusion as a valid enum but did not check its semantic relation to gate_result.
semantic_trace: shared/skills/review/scripts/completion_check.sh:79 calls the new semantic validator from validate_review_result.

fix_questions.question: root cause
fix_questions.answer: Runtime validation stopped at enum and presence checks, leaving the review skill's conclusion mapping unenforced.

fix_questions.question: completeness
fix_questions.answer: The fix covers APPROVE/PASS, REQUEST_CHANGES/FAIL, COMMENT/FAIL, and rejects broader shared enum values for review output.

fix_questions.question: new risk
fix_questions.answer: The stricter check changes only review code-review-result validation; existing PASS/APPROVE fixture remains accepted.

fix_questions.question: test coverage
fix_questions.answer: tests/test-review-canonical-result-gate.sh covers valid PASS/APPROVE and invalid PASS/REQUEST_CHANGES.

issues.title: review findings accepted non-real locators
issues.symptom: Findings with parent traversal paths, missing repo-local files, or out-of-range line numbers were structurally valid.

reproduction.red_result: exit 1 before fix at the first gate mismatch; subsequent negative cases documented the expected locator blocks before implementation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The schema rejects non repo-local finding paths.
hypotheses.verification_method: Read contracts/canonical/schemas/runtime/code-review-result.schema.json lines 163-169 before the schema patch.
hypotheses.evidence: Pre-fix file_path was only type string with minLength 1.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The completion hook validates path existence and file line bounds.
hypotheses.verification_method: Read shared/skills/review/scripts/completion_check.sh lines 51-57 before the hook patch.
hypotheses.evidence: Pre-fix findings validation checked file_path string length, line_number >= 1, confidence, and verification_status only.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Schema can enforce repo-local syntax but runtime must enforce filesystem existence and line bounds.
hypotheses.verification_method: Compare JSON Schema static checks with hook REPO_ROOT availability from shared/hooks/lib/common.sh hook_init.
hypotheses.evidence: Schema now rejects parent traversal at contracts/canonical/schemas/runtime/code-review-result.schema.json:163; hook now checks files and line counts at shared/skills/review/scripts/completion_check.sh:95.

root_cause.summary: The schema and hook accepted syntactically non-empty locator fields without repo-local syntax, existing file, or line-bound enforcement.
semantic_trace: shared/skills/review/SKILL.md:120 requires each finding to carry file_path:line_number evidence.
shared/skills/review/scripts/completion_check.sh:95 now resolves findings against REPO_ROOT and checks one-based line bounds.

fix_questions.question: root cause
fix_questions.answer: Locator fields were treated as shape-only data instead of evidence anchors to real repo files.

fix_questions.question: completeness
fix_questions.answer: The fix blocks absolute or parent-traversal paths, missing repo-local files, non-integer line numbers, and line numbers greater than the file length.

fix_questions.question: new risk
fix_questions.answer: Only non-empty findings are resolved; existing review reports with no findings keep the same pass path.

fix_questions.question: test coverage
fix_questions.answer: tests/test-review-canonical-result-gate.sh covers parent traversal, missing repo-local file, schema path rejection, and out-of-range line number.

changes.summary: Added review_conclusion/gate_result alignment, positive integer line checks, repo-local path validation, file existence checks, and file line-bound checks.
Added a file_path pattern that rejects absolute paths and parent traversal segments.
Added RED/GREEN hook and schema regression coverage for valid output, mismatched conclusion, path traversal, missing file, and line overflow.
Registered the new review canonical gate regression in syntax and full-suite plans.

dependency_chain: completion_check.sh validates code-review-result.json during hook execution
canonical schema validator validates code-review-result artifacts
standard-chain readiness and registry tests consume canonical review artifacts
